easy: A pile of something that has slowly gathered in one place.

ex.en: The buildup of snow blocked our front door.
ex.ko: 쌓인 눈이 우리 집 현관문을 막았다.

easy: The religion of Christians who follow the Pope.

ex.en: My grandmother goes to church every Sunday to practice her Catholicism.
ex.ko: 할머니는 가톨릭 신앙을 지키려고 일요일마다 성당에 가신다.

easy: Tied up with metal rings joined together.

ex.en: The chained dog could not leave the yard.
ex.ko: 사슬에 묶인 개는 마당을 벗어날 수 없었다.

easy: A group of people with their own way of life, art, and rules in a certain time and place.

ex.en: Ancient Egypt was a great civilization.
ex.ko: 고대 이집트는 위대한 문명이었다.

easy: A hard, silver-gray metal that is used to make a deep blue color.

ex.en: Cobalt is a metal that makes paint a deep blue.
ex.ko: 코발트는 물감을 짙은 파란색으로 만드는 금속이다.

easy: Extremely big, so big that it makes you say wow.

ex.en: The dinosaur skeleton in the museum was colossal.
ex.ko: 박물관의 공룡 뼈대는 거대했다.

easy: A line on a map that joins places that are the same height.

ex.en: The contour lines on the map show where the hill is steep.
ex.ko: 지도의 등고선은 언덕이 가파른 곳을 보여 준다.

easy: Hard and easy to break in a nice way, like fresh chips.

ex.en: The fried chicken was hot and crispy.
ex.ko: 프라이드치킨은 뜨겁고 바삭바삭했다.

easy: Without any doubt at all.

ex.en: The soup was decidedly too salty.
ex.ko: 그 수프는 분명히 너무 짰다.

easy: A wrong idea that someone believes even though it is not true.

ex.en: He had the delusion that he could fly like a bird.
ex.ko: 그는 새처럼 날 수 있다는 착각에 빠져 있었다.

easy: To pick someone or something and give it a name or a job.

ex.en: The teacher designated Mina as the line leader.
ex.ko: 선생님은 미나를 줄반장으로 지정했다.

easy: Unhappy because you want something better.

ex.en: The discontent kids frowned when recess ended early.
ex.ko: 쉬는 시간이 일찍 끝나자 불만스러운 아이들이 얼굴을 찌푸렸다.

easy: The unhappy feeling you get when you want something better.

ex.en: There was discontent in the class when the party was canceled.
ex.ko: 파티가 취소되자 반 아이들 사이에 불만이 퍼졌다.

easy: A big wall of dirt or stone that holds back water.

ex.en: The farmers built a dyke to keep the sea out.
ex.ko: 농부들은 바닷물을 막으려고 제방을 쌓았다.

easy: Making a sound that bounces back, so you hear it again.

ex.en: We shouted inside the echoing cave.
ex.ko: 우리는 메아리치는 동굴 안에서 소리를 질렀다.

easy: Feeling very, very happy.

ex.en: She was ecstatic when she got a puppy.
ex.ko: 그녀는 강아지를 얻자 너무 기뻐서 황홀해했다.

easy: Found naturally in only one place in the world.

ex.en: Koalas are endemic to Australia.
ex.ko: 코알라는 호주에만 사는 고유종이다.

easy: To sign up to join the army or navy.

ex.en: My uncle enlisted in the army after high school.
ex.ko: 삼촌은 고등학교를 졸업하고 군에 입대했다.

easy: A person whose job is to put out fires.

ex.en: The firefighter climbed a ladder to save the cat.
ex.ko: 소방관은 고양이를 구하려고 사다리를 올라갔다.

easy: Very bright in color, as if it glows.

ex.en: I wear a fluorescent vest when I ride my bike at dusk.
ex.ko: 나는 해 질 녘에 자전거를 탈 때 형광 조끼를 입는다.

easy: Possible to tell what or who it is.

ex.en: The bird was identifiable by its red tail.
ex.ko: 그 새는 빨간 꼬리로 알아볼 수 있었다.

easy: Not able to read or write.
ko: 글을 읽고 쓸 줄 모르는, 문맹의

ex.en: Long ago, many people were illiterate because they never went to school.
ex.ko: 옛날에는 학교에 가 보지 못해 글을 읽고 쓸 줄 모르는 사람이 많았다.

easy: Perfectly neat and clean.

ex.en: My grandma's kitchen is always immaculate.
ex.ko: 할머니의 부엌은 언제나 티끌 하나 없이 깨끗하다.

easy: Made quickly with whatever things you have nearby.

ex.en: We made an improvised tent from a blanket and two chairs.
ex.ko: 우리는 담요와 의자 두 개로 임시 텐트를 만들었다.

easy: Having to do with how people get along with each other.

ex.en: Being kind to friends is an important interpersonal skill.
ex.ko: 친구에게 친절한 것은 중요한 대인 관계 능력이다.

easy: Between people of different races.

ex.en: Our class has many interracial friendships.
ex.ko: 우리 반에는 인종이 다른 친구들 사이의 우정이 많다.

easy: A person who comes in where he is not allowed to be.

ex.en: Our dog barked at the intruder in the yard.
ex.ko: 우리 개가 마당의 침입자를 보고 짖었다.

easy: Inside your mind, not shown to other people.

ex.en: She kept her inward worries a secret.
ex.ko: 그녀는 마음속 걱정을 비밀로 했다.

easy: Going toward the inside or the middle.

ex.en: The door swings inward, not outward.
ex.ko: 그 문은 바깥쪽이 아니라 안쪽으로 열린다.

easy: The feeling on your skin that makes you want to scratch.

ex.en: The itching from the mosquito bite kept me awake.
ex.ko: 모기 물린 곳이 가려워서 잠을 잘 수 없었다.

easy: To make something smaller or less.

ex.en: A cold drink can lessen the pain of a sore throat.
ex.ko: 차가운 음료는 목이 아픈 것을 덜어 줄 수 있다.

easy: Going along the long side of something.

ex.en: The cake had a long cut running lengthwise, so it was longitudinal.
ex.ko: 케이크에는 길이 방향으로 칼집이 나 있었다.

easy: To make something less tight.

ex.en: I loosened my shoelaces after the race.
ex.ko: 나는 달리기가 끝난 뒤 신발 끈을 느슨하게 풀었다.

easy: To make rules less strict.

ex.en: The school loosened the rules about hats.
ex.ko: 학교는 모자에 관한 규칙을 완화했다.

easy: So tiny that you can only see it with a special tool.

ex.en: Germs are microscopic, so we cannot see them with our eyes.
ex.ko: 세균은 너무 작아서 맨눈으로 볼 수 없다.

easy: A low sound people make when they hurt or are unhappy.

ex.en: We heard a moan from the sick puppy.
ex.ko: 우리는 아픈 강아지가 끙끙대는 소리를 들었다.

easy: To make a sound that shows you hurt or are unhappy.

ex.en: The kids moaned when the teacher gave extra homework.
ex.ko: 선생님이 숙제를 더 내주자 아이들은 끙 앓는 소리를 냈다.

easy: Going all the way without stopping.

ex.en: We took a nonstop flight to Seoul.
ex.ko: 우리는 서울행 직항 비행기를 탔다.

easy: Going on all the time without a break.

ex.en: It was nonstop rain all day.
ex.ko: 하루 종일 쉬지 않고 비가 내렸다.

easy: In a way that many people know about, and it is not good.

ex.en: The road is notoriously slippery after rain.
ex.ko: 그 길은 비가 오면 미끄럽기로 악명이 높다.

easy: A warm, soft breakfast food made by cooking oats.

ex.en: I eat oatmeal with banana for breakfast.
ex.ko: 나는 아침으로 바나나를 넣은 오트밀을 먹는다.

easy: A food made from oats that are flattened or ground.

ex.en: Mom mixed oatmeal into the cookie dough.
ex.ko: 엄마는 쿠키 반죽에 오트밀을 섞었다.

easy: A furry animal that swims in rivers and eats fish.

ex.en: The otter floated on its back and cracked open a clam.
ex.ko: 수달은 등을 대고 떠서 조개를 깨 먹었다.

easy: The line on your head where hair is combed to two sides.

ex.en: Mom made a straight parting in my hair.
ex.ko: 엄마는 내 머리에 곧게 가르마를 탔다.

easy: A dry powder that gives color to paint.

ex.en: Artists mix pigment with oil to make paint.
ex.ko: 화가들은 안료를 기름과 섞어 물감을 만든다.

easy: The natural stuff in plants and animals that gives them their color.

ex.en: The green pigment in leaves is called chlorophyll.
ex.ko: 나뭇잎의 초록색 색소는 엽록소라고 한다.

easy: Having tiny holes so water can soak in.

ex.en: A sponge is porous, so it soaks up water.
ex.ko: 스펀지는 물이 스며들어서 물을 빨아들인다.

easy: Full of tiny holes.

ex.en: Bread is porous, with lots of tiny holes.
ex.ko: 빵은 작은 구멍이 아주 많다.

easy: To pull the reins to make a horse slow down or stop.

ex.en: The rider reined in her horse at the gate.
ex.ko: 기수는 문 앞에서 말의 고삐를 당겨 세웠다.

easy: A very old thing that is still around from long ago.

ex.en: The museum has a relic from ancient Greece.
ex.ko: 그 박물관에는 고대 그리스의 유물이 있다.

easy: A thing you keep to remember a person or a time.

ex.en: Grandpa's old watch is a family relic.
ex.ko: 할아버지의 낡은 시계는 우리 집안의 소중한 유품이다.

easy: To come together again after being apart.

ex.en: The family reunited at the airport after two years.
ex.ko: 가족은 2년 만에 공항에서 다시 만났다.

easy: To become one again after being split.

ex.en: The two parts of the country reunited after the war.
ex.ko: 그 나라의 두 지역은 전쟁 뒤에 다시 하나가 되었다.

easy: To use something again instead of throwing it away.

ex.en: We reuse old jars to hold pencils.
ex.ko: 우리는 낡은 병을 연필꽂이로 다시 쓴다.

easy: The part of a road where cars drive.

ex.en: Look both ways before you step onto the roadway.
ex.ko: 차도에 발을 내딛기 전에 양쪽을 살펴라.

easy: Simple and plain, like life in the country.

ex.en: We stayed in a rustic cabin by the lake.
ex.ko: 우리는 호숫가의 소박한 통나무집에서 묵었다.

easy: Clean and free from germs.

ex.en: Wash your hands to keep the kitchen sanitary.
ex.ko: 부엌을 위생적으로 유지하려면 손을 씻어라.

easy: Pretty big.

ex.en: We caught a sizable fish at the lake.
ex.ko: 우리는 호수에서 꽤 큰 물고기를 잡았다.

easy: Quite a lot in amount.

ex.en: She saved a sizable amount of money.
ex.ko: 그녀는 상당한 돈을 모았다.

easy: A person who breathes in the smoke of burning tobacco.

ex.en: My uncle was a smoker, but he quit.
ex.ko: 삼촌은 흡연자였지만 담배를 끊었다.

easy: The act of holding something tight and pressing it.

ex.en: Squeezing the toy made it squeak.
ex.ko: 장난감을 꽉 쥐자 삑 소리가 났다.

easy: To hit someone so hard that they feel dizzy and can't think.

ex.en: The ball hit his head and stunned him for a second.
ex.ko: 공이 머리에 맞아 그는 잠시 멍해졌다.

easy: A short nail with a sharp point and a wide flat top.

ex.en: I pinned the poster to the board with a tack.
ex.ko: 나는 압정으로 포스터를 게시판에 꽂았다.

easy: A small pie with no top and fruit inside.

ex.en: Grandma baked a strawberry tart.
ex.ko: 할머니가 딸기 타르트를 구우셨다.

easy: A soft paste you put on a brush to clean your teeth.

ex.en: Put a little toothpaste on your toothbrush.
ex.ko: 칫솔에 치약을 조금 짜라.

easy: A machine that changes electricity from one strength to another.

ex.en: A transformer on the pole changes the electricity for our houses.
ex.ko: 전봇대의 변압기가 우리 집에 맞게 전기를 바꿔 준다.

easy: Lasting only a very short time.

ex.en: The rainbow was transient and faded in minutes.
ex.ko: 무지개는 잠깐 떴다가 몇 분 만에 사라졌다.

easy: Very happy and proud because you won or did well.

ex.en: The team was triumphant after winning the game.
ex.ko: 팀은 경기에서 이기고 승리감에 차 있었다.

easy: The person who decides if a play is fair in a baseball game.

ex.en: The umpire yelled, "Strike three!"
ex.ko: 심판이 "스트라이크 쓰리!"라고 외쳤다.

easy: A person picked to decide who is right in an argument.

ex.en: Our teacher acted as umpire when we argued about the rules.
ex.ko: 규칙 때문에 우리가 다투자 선생님이 중재자 역할을 하셨다.

easy: Not yet born.

ex.en: We should keep Earth clean for unborn generations.
ex.ko: 우리는 아직 태어나지 않은 세대를 위해 지구를 깨끗이 지켜야 한다.

easy: Not told to other people.

ex.en: They hid the treasure in an undisclosed place.
ex.ko: 그들은 보물을 밝혀지지 않은 장소에 숨겼다.

easy: Not finished or not yet done.

ex.en: My homework is still undone.
ex.ko: 내 숙제는 아직 끝내지 못했다.

easy: Not heard by anyone.

ex.en: Her small voice went unheard in the noisy room.
ex.ko: 그녀의 작은 목소리는 시끄러운 방에서 아무에게도 들리지 않았다.

easy: To pull or twist something hard and fast to get it off.

ex.en: The wind wrenched the umbrella out of my hand.
ex.ko: 바람이 내 손에서 우산을 홱 낚아챘다.

easy: Very bad or in very poor shape.

ex.en: The old hut was in wretched condition.
ex.ko: 그 낡은 오두막은 상태가 형편없었다.

easy: Feeling very uncomfortable, like when it is cold and wet.

ex.en: We waited for the bus in the wretched cold and rain.
ex.ko: 우리는 비참할 만큼 춥고 비 오는 날씨에 버스를 기다렸다.

easy: The big system of websites you reach with the internet.

ex.en: I looked up pictures of sharks on the web.
ex.ko: 나는 웹에서 상어 사진을 찾아보았다.

easy: The years when a kid is growing into a grown-up.

ex.en: My big brother is in his adolescence and is growing fast.
ex.ko: 우리 형은 사춘기라서 키가 빨리 크고 있다.

easy: A gas with a very strong smell, used in some cleaners.

ex.en: Ammonia has a strong smell, so be careful with cleaners.
ex.ko: 암모니아는 냄새가 강하니 세제를 조심해서 써라.

easy: Alike in some ways, even if different in others.

ex.en: A heart is analogous to a pump.
ex.ko: 심장은 펌프와 비슷하다.

easy: Cloth you tie around your waist to keep your clothes clean.

ex.en: Dad wore an apron while he cooked pancakes.
ex.ko: 아빠는 팬케이크를 만드는 동안 앞치마를 입으셨다.

easy: So old that it seems to come from long ago.

ex.en: A horse and cart looks archaic next to a car.
ex.ko: 말과 수레는 자동차 옆에서 보면 아주 구식으로 보인다.

easy: The sound of hands hitting together to show you like something.

ex.en: The clapping got louder when the singer came out.
ex.ko: 가수가 나오자 박수 소리가 더 커졌다.

easy: A small green plant with three round leaves.

ex.en: I found a four-leaf clover in the grass.
ex.ko: 나는 풀밭에서 네잎클로버를 찾았다.

easy: A book that shows you how to cook food.

ex.en: Mom found the cake recipe in her cookbook.
ex.ko: 엄마는 요리책에서 케이크 만드는 법을 찾았다.

easy: To make a place look nicer with things like balloons and flowers.

ex.en: We decorated the classroom with balloons for the party.
ex.ko: 우리는 파티를 위해 교실을 풍선으로 장식했다.

easy: To look pretty on something.

ex.en: Colorful flowers decorated the birthday table.
ex.ko: 알록달록한 꽃들이 생일 상을 꾸며 주었다.

easy: A straight line from one corner of a shape to a far corner.

ex.en: Draw a diagonal from one corner of the square to the opposite one.
ex.ko: 정사각형의 한 모서리에서 맞은편 모서리까지 대각선을 그어 보아라.

easy: To make people stop trusting or believing someone.

ex.en: The lie discredited her story.
ex.ko: 그 거짓말 때문에 그녀의 이야기는 신뢰를 잃었다.
